paper.title: WebRider: Persona-Conditioned Intent Controllers for Live-Web Assistance
paper.abstract: Delegating a web task involves more than asking a question; it requires transferring a policy: what to verify, how to handle uncertainty, which preferences matter, and when to stop. Yet, current live-web agents are evaluated solely on the final answer, ignoring the policy constraints that define the delegation. A plausible final answer can conceal violations of that policy. Our full live audit reveals this critical gap: a strong controller completes 99.2% of tasks but honors all policy constrain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“网页任务能否做完”，而是“代理是否沿着用户委托的方式把任务做完”。作者指出，现有 live-web agent 评测几乎都只看最终答案或任务完成率，忽略了执行过程中的策略约束：要核验哪些证据、遇到不确定性时是否该追问、哪些偏好必须进入排序、什么时候应该停止而不是继续猜。问题的难点在于，这类委托策略不是静态标签，而是会贯穿浏览、点击、检索、澄清、停止、回答整个闭环；而且 live web 页面持续变化，最终答案即便看起来合理，也可能是在违反用户 policy 的情况下得到的。作者把这类可审计的委托策略形式化为 intent contract，并把核心问题定义为：如何在动态网页环境中，让 agent 在每一步都保持对 contract 的忠实执行，而不是只在终点上“看起来答对了”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，这篇论文不是训练范式或数据配比层面的工作，相关性偏间接；但它对 agent 训练信号设计和过程监督有一个清楚的提醒：只用 outcome supervision 会系统性掩盖 policy violation。论文给出的结果很直接：一个强 controller 在 99.2% 的 contract 上都能终止，但只有 38.8% 真正满足全部 contract gate。这个差距说明，若训练或评测只看 final success，会把大量“路径错但答案像对”的轨迹当成正样本。对做 post-train、tool-use、web agent 数据合成的人，这意味着需要把可验证的中间控制状态、证据义务和 stopping policy 显式写进训练对象，而不是只收集问答对。对 pretrain 研究员的启发主要在接口层：如果未来想把 agentic behavior 更早地纳入 continual pretrain 或 mid-train，监督对象不能只有文本结果，还要有结构化的过程约束。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，WebRider的关键设计是把“长期委托控制”和“当前页面动作实现”硬性拆开，而不是让一个单体 LLM 在同一上下文里同时负责计划、证据判断、动作生成和终止决策。顶层 controller 维护一个显式状态，里面包含 goal、hard constraints、soft preferences、blocking conditions、evidence ledger、progress 和 next intention。它只负责高层决策：继续浏览、发起澄清、停止、标记外部阻塞、还是给出答案；如果继续浏览，它会发出一个紧凑的 intention，例如“核验该商品的退货政策”或“为兼容性再找一个来源”。

中层不允许判断“证据是否足够”或“是否可以最终回答”，它只根据当前 observation、顶层 intention、persona state 和近期历史，生成一个且仅一个可执行的 JSON Action AST，动作空间包括 Click、Type、Scroll、Search、Maps、Back、Wait 以及安全回退。这里的重点不是让模型自由生成文本动作，而是通过确定性的 compiler 和 guard 把动作约束成可执行、可校验的局部目标：语法错误、非法 target、重复状态、阻塞状态都会被拦截，并附带恢复动作。训练时监督的不是原始模型文本，而是 guard 之后最终真正执行的 action。这样做的好处是，中层 policy 的学习目标被压缩成一个局部、可验证、可替换的 action realization 问题，而 CAPTCHA、访问策略、证据充分性、最终回答等复杂控制仍由 guard 或顶层负责。

另一条主线是 persona-conditioned intent contract。作者强调 persona 不是人口统计属性，也不是长期记忆，而是任务局部的控制策略，决定证据收集、排序偏好、不确定性处理和 stopping 规则。contract 由 goal、硬约束、软偏好、阻塞条件、证据义务、答案 schema 等组成，并且除非用户显式澄清，否则在执行期间保持稳定。这个设计让同一个 request 在固定 hard constraints 下可以配不同 persona，形成 counterfactual setting，用来测“同一个任务，不同委托 policy 下 agent 是否真的走了不同且正确的路径”。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最有信息量的是评测设置和误差分解，而不是模型规模。作者构建了 RiderBench：从 768 个审计过的请求扩展到 4,096 个 persona-conditioned contracts，覆盖 42 个网站，并且支持同一请求在不同 persona 下的配对比较。核心指标不是单一 success，而是 contract gates 和人工配对审计，检查完成轨迹与可见步骤是否同时满足委托 policy。

最关键的数字是：强基线 Full-Pro 在 99.2% 的 contract 上都能终止，但只有 38.8% 通过全部 contract gate。也就是说，终止率和 delegation fidelity 明显脱钩。论文还做了 paired human study，结论是 final-trace success 与 stepwise acceptability 存在显著偏离：最终答案可能被人类判为“看起来可接受”，但逐步检查时会发现它没有按要求核验证据、没有在该追问时追问，或者在 persona 指定的风险偏好下做了不该做的扩展搜索。

机制实验主要围绕 persistent intention 的价值。作者比较了仅给 persona、仅给 intention 文本、以及显式持久 intention 状态等设置，结论是持续维护的 intention 对控制质量更关键，不是简单把 persona 描述塞进 prompt 就能替代。另一个重要点是 guarded middle traces 的可训练性：由于每一步都有 post-guard 的可执行 action 作为局部监督目标，中层 policy 可以在固定顶层 controller、guard 和 executor 的条件下单独训练与替换。这说明作者不是只提出一个评测框架，而是在尝试把 agent 过程控制切成可学习、可审计的模块。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只是泛读，先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住论文真正要解决的不是网页导航成功率，而是 delegation fidelity。接着看 Hierarchical Controller，重点理解为什么顶层和中层必须强分离，以及为什么训练目标要定义成 post-guard executable action，而不是自由文本动作。这里是整篇工作的结构支点。

然后看 Persona-Conditioned Intent Contracts，注意 contract 里哪些字段是稳定的，哪些只能通过显式 user clarification 更新。作者想解决的是“执行中 policy 漂移”，所以 contract 的稳定性假设很关键。

实验部分优先看 RiderBench 的构造方式、contract gates 的定义、99.2% vs 38.8% 这组 headline 数字，以及 paired human study。这里能看清作者为什么说“完成不等于忠实”。如果时间够，再看 persistent intention 的消融和 guarded middle traces 的训练分析，这两部分决定这篇工作是否只是评测包装，还是对 agent 训练接口有实质贡献。

预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。对做 pretrain 的读者，不必在网页执行细节上停留太久，重点看监督对象如何从 final answer 改写为结构化过程状态，以及这种改写如何产生更干净的训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about whether a web agent can finish a task, but whether it can preserve the user’s delegated policy while doing so. Current live-web evaluation mostly scores final answers or completion, which misses a central failure mode: the agent may produce a plausible answer after ignoring the user’s verification requirements, uncertainty policy, ranking preferences, or stopping criteria. This is especially problematic on the live web, where evidence arrives incrementally, pages change, and browsing, grounding, clarification, and stopping are tightly coupled. The paper formalizes this missing object as an intent contract and asks a sharper question: how can an agent maintain contract fidelity at every visible step, rather than merely ending with an acceptable-looking answer?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, and its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. Still, it makes an important point for training-signal design: outcome-only supervision systematically hides policy violations. The headline number is the reason to care: a strong controller terminates on 99.2% of contracts, but only 38.8% satisfy all contract gates. That gap means many trajectories that look successful at the endpoint are actually bad supervision if one cares about delegated behavior. For post-training, tool-use, and web-agent data generation, the implication is clear: intermediate control state, evidence obligations, and stopping policy need to be explicit training targets. For pretraining researchers, the value is at the pretrain↔post-train interface: if agentic behavior is ever pushed earlier into continual pretraining or mid-training, final text alone is too weak a target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main design choice is a hard separation between long-horizon delegation control and page-local action realization. Instead of letting one monolithic LLM jointly decide plans, evidence sufficiency, browser actions, and stopping, WebRider uses a hierarchy.

The top layer maintains an explicit state containing the goal, hard constraints, soft preferences, blocking conditions, evidence ledger, progress, and next intention. It decides whether to continue browsing, ask for clarification, stop, flag an external blocker, or answer. If browsing continues, it emits a compact intention such as “verify the return policy for this candidate” or “find a second source for compatibility.”

The middle layer is deliberately narrower. Given the current observation, the top-layer intention, persona state, and recent history, it emits exactly one JSON Action AST from a constrained action space: Click, Type, Scroll, Search, Maps, Back, Wait, or a safe fallback. Crucially, it is not allowed to decide whether evidence is sufficient or whether the task is ready for final answer. A deterministic compiler plus guards enforce executability: malformed targets, invalid terminals, repeated states, and blocked states are intercepted, with recovery actions attached when needed. Training supervision is defined on the final post-guard executable action, not on raw model text. That turns the middle policy into a local, verifiable action-realization problem, while harder issues such as CAPTCHA, access policy, evidence sufficiency, and final answering remain with the guards or the top layer.

The second core contribution is the persona-conditioned intent contract. Persona here is not demographic identity or long-term memory; it is a task-local control policy governing evidence gathering, uncertainty handling, ranking, interaction, and stopping. The contract includes the goal, hard constraints, soft preferences, blockers, evidence obligations, and answer schema, and remains stable unless the user explicitly clarifies. This lets the benchmark create counterfactual variants of the same request under different personas, so the evaluation can test whether the agent truly follows different delegated policies under fixed hard constraints.
summary_en.experiments:
The most informative part of the empirical section is the evaluation design and the failure decomposition, not model scaling. The paper introduces RiderBench, expanding 768 audited requests into 4,096 persona-conditioned contracts across 42 sites. The setup supports paired comparisons: the same request can be evaluated under different personas while keeping hard constraints and evidence obligations fixed.

The key result is the gap between completion and fidelity. The strong baseline controller, Full-Pro, terminates on 99.2% of contracts, but only 38.8% pass all contract gates. In other words, finishing the task and honoring the delegated policy are very different things. The paired human study reinforces this point: final-trace success and stepwise acceptability diverge significantly. A trajectory may look acceptable from the final answer alone, yet fail under stepwise audit because it skipped required evidence checks, failed to ask when uncertainty should have triggered clarification, or violated the persona’s risk policy.

The mechanism studies focus on persistent intention. The paper compares settings such as persona-only prompting, intention text alone, and explicit persistent intention state, and finds that maintaining intention as a state variable matters more than merely including persona text in the prompt. Another useful result concerns trainability of the middle layer: because each step yields a guarded executable action as a local target, the middle policy can be trained and swapped while holding the top controller, guards, and executor fixed. That makes the proposal more than an evaluation wrapper; it is also a modular training interface for process-level control.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1. The central claim is that web-agent evaluation is missing delegation fidelity, not just task success. Then read the Hierarchical Controller section carefully. The key question is why the top and middle layers must be structurally separated, and why supervision is placed on post-guard executable actions rather than free-form action text. That is the architectural core.

Next, read the intent contract section with attention to what is stable and what can change only through explicit user clarification. The paper is trying to prevent policy drift during execution, so the stability of the contract is not a minor detail.

In the experiments, prioritize the RiderBench construction, the definition of contract gates, the 99.2% vs 38.8% result, and the paired human study. Those pieces establish why endpoint-only evaluation is insufficient. If time remains, read the ablations on persistent intention and the analysis of guarded middle traces. Those sections determine whether the work is merely a benchmark proposal or a meaningful training interface for agent control.

A reasonable skim takes about 25–35 minutes. For a pretraining-oriented reader, the main value is not browser mechanics but how the supervision target is shifted from final answers to structured process state.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 的 99.2/38.8 缺口和 intent contract 设计即可；它会影响 agent reward 怎么写。
recommendation.en: Read the 99.2/38.8 completion-fidelity gap and the intent-contract design; it matters for how agent rewards should be specified.

paper.title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on memory to reuse experiences, yet existing memory systems often assume that evidence can be directly consumed through a fixed representation. This leads to representation mismatch, where relevant information is available but not organized for the current decision. To this end, we propose MemPrism, a task-conditioned relational memory framework that separates persistent experience storage from decision-time working memory. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是长程 agent memory 里的一个更细的失败类型：信息已经被存下来了，也被取回来了，但呈现方式不适合当前决策，因此 agent 仍然用不好。作者把这个问题称为 representation mismatch，并把它和更常见的 storage failure、retrieval failure 区分开。核心问题不是“记忆有没有”，而是“同一段历史在当前子任务下应该以什么关系结构被组织出来”。例如，检测循环需要把重复动作和结果对齐，状态跟踪需要按实体聚合同一对象的变化，失败分析需要把动作和环境反馈连起来，依赖分析则需要把相隔很远的事件串起来。固定的时间线、摘要或向量检索结果，往往只能支持其中一类关系，不能覆盖所有决策需求。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为这不是基座模型训练论文；但它对 agent memory 的接口设计提出了一个有价值的拆分：持久记忆应保存稳定事实，工作记忆应按当前任务临时构造。这个拆分对做长上下文、memory-augmented LM、tool-use agent 的人都有启发。很多系统把 memory 问题理解成“怎么压缩、怎么检索、怎么写回”，这篇论文强调还差一步：检索之后如何重排成当前策略真正可消费的结构。若把这个观点放到更广的训练视角，它提示我们，模型性能不只受知识覆盖影响，也受输入组织形式影响；同样的证据，换一种结构化呈现，决策质量可能明显不同。
summary.technical_approach:
MemPrism 的方法核心是把 persistent memory 和 decision-time working memory 明确分开。系统由五个模块组成：Recorder、Router、Composer、Render、Adapter。推理时主要用前四个模块。Recorder 把真实交互记录成统一 event stream，既保留原始事件，也保留结构化字段，如动作前观察、执行动作、环境反馈、奖励或步骤标签、任务元信息等。这里的设计意图是让持久层尽量保持中性和可复用，不提前把历史压缩成某一种固定摘要。

Router 是一个轻量的 view policy，它不直接输出环境动作，而是先选择“该怎么看历史”。作者把 view action 定义成几个维度的组合：relation type、evidence range、outcome condition、granularity。也就是，当前该构造哪种关系视图、看多长的历史、是否只看成功/失败/特定结果、以及细节粒度多粗。这个设计把 memory read-time 的表示选择显式化了。

Composer 根据 Router 的选择，从 event stream 中筛选事件并组织成关系结构；Render 再把这个结构渲染成 optical working-memory view。作者使用 optical view，不只是为了压缩 token，而是为了把关系直接编码进二维布局：空间邻近表示相关性，行列对齐支持状态比较，箭头表示变化或依赖，高亮强调失败点和任务相关证据。随后，一个冻结的 task policy 读取当前输入和这个临时视图，输出下一步环境动作。这个视图只服务当前一步，之后丢弃，不写回持久记忆。这样可以避免固定摘要或反复压缩带来的不可逆失真。

训练上，作者给 Router 加了两阶段学习。先用 action-conditioned soft supervision 初始化 view policy，再用 trajectory-level grouped GRPO 优化。这里的目标不是直接学环境动作，而是学“在当前状态下选哪种 memory view 更有利于后续决策”。这种分离有助于把性能提升更明确地归因到 memory representation interface，而不是混杂在整个 agent policy 里。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验主线围绕 view selection 是否真的改善长程决策，而不是单纯比较存储容量。作者强调两类证据：一类是任务性能提升，另一类是归因实验，证明收益来自 working-memory 视图而不是别的模块。论文介绍里提到，view policy 先用软监督初始化，再用 grouped GRPO 做轨迹级优化，目的就是隔离 view selection 的作用。

虽然当前提供的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但可以确定作者会比较固定表示与 task-conditioned relational views：例如只给时间线、只给摘要、只给原始检索片段，与按 relation type / evidence range / outcome filter / granularity 动态构造的视图相比，后者在 loop detection、state tracking、failure analysis、dependency reasoning 这类子任务上更合适。另一个关键实验点应是 temporary view 不写回 persistent memory 的设计：作者认为如果把临时视图再写回，会把某一步的任务偏置固化到长期记忆里，损害后续复用性，因此会通过消融展示 persistent event stream + on-demand view 比固定 summary memory 更稳。

如果拿这篇论文做泛读，实验部分最该找的是三类结果：第一，Router 学到的 view action 分布是否随任务状态变化；第二，固定 view 与动态 view 的性能差距；第三，光学视图相对纯文本或扁平检索结果的增益是否来自结构显式化，而不只是 token 压缩。
summary.reading_guide:
先看 Introduction，把作者提出的 representation mismatch 和 storage / retrieval failure 的边界弄清楚。这个定义是整篇论文成立的前提。如果不接受这个问题分解，后面的模块设计会显得像是在做另一种 memory engineering。

然后重点看 Method 里的五模块流水线，尤其是 Router 的 action space。阅读时要问两个问题：为什么 view selection 要单独建模，而不是交给主 policy 自己在 prompt 里隐式完成；为什么 temporary working view 不写回 persistent memory。前者关系到可学习的 memory interface，后者关系到长期记忆是否被任务局部偏置污染。

接着看 optical view 的具体例子。不要只把它理解成“把历史画成图像节省 token”，作者真正想强调的是二维布局能显式表达关系结构。若论文里有可视化案例，值得仔细看，因为这部分决定方法是否只是换了输入模态，还是确实改变了信息组织方式。

实验部分建议优先看 view policy 的训练方式、固定视图对比、以及不同 relation type 的消融。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。对 pretrain 读者，重点不是 agent benchmark 本身，而是“同一证据如何以不同结构暴露给模型”这个接口问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in long-horizon agent memory: the needed evidence has been stored and even retrieved, yet the agent still fails because the evidence is presented in the wrong form for the current decision. The authors call this representation mismatch and distinguish it from storage failure and retrieval failure. The key question is not whether memory exists, but how the same interaction history should be reorganized for different subtasks. Loop detection, state tracking, failure analysis, and dependency reasoning require different relational structures over the same events, and a single fixed representation rarely serves all of them well.
summary_en.importance: This is not a foundation-model pretraining paper, so the relevance is indirect. Still, it offers a useful systems-level idea for memory-augmented LMs and long-horizon agents: persistent memory should preserve stable facts, while working memory should be constructed on demand for the current task. Many memory systems focus on what to store, how to compress, and how to retrieve. MemPrism argues that one more layer matters: how retrieved evidence is organized before it reaches the policy. In a broader training sense, the paper is a reminder that model performance depends not only on knowledge coverage but also on input organization. The same evidence can support very different decisions depending on how relations are exposed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MemPrism explicitly separates persistent memory from decision-time working memory. The framework has five modules: Recorder, Router, Composer, Render, and Adapter. In inference, the first four form the main pipeline. Recorder stores real interactions as a unified event stream, keeping both raw events and structured fields such as pre-action observation, executed action, environment feedback, reward or step label, and task metadata. The point is to keep persistent memory neutral and reusable rather than collapsing it early into one fixed summary.

Router is the key learnable component. Instead of directly predicting the next environment action, it first decides how history should be viewed. A view action is defined over several axes: relation type, evidence range, outcome condition, and granularity. In other words, the policy chooses what relational structure to build, how much history to include, whether to filter by success/failure or other outcomes, and how coarse or fine the representation should be. This makes read-time memory representation an explicit decision variable.

Composer then selects events from the event stream and assembles a relational structure according to the chosen view action. Render converts that structure into an optical working-memory view. The optical format is not used only for token compression. The authors use two-dimensional layout to encode relations directly: spatial proximity groups related events, row/column alignment supports state comparison, arrows indicate change or dependency, and highlights emphasize failures or task-relevant evidence. A frozen task policy consumes the current input together with this temporary view and outputs the next environment action. The view is discarded after the step and is never written back into persistent memory, which avoids irreversible distortion from fixed summaries or repeated compression.

Training is also split cleanly. Router is first initialized with action-conditioned soft supervision, then optimized with trajectory-level grouped GRPO. The learning target is not the environment action itself, but the choice of memory view that best supports downstream action selection. This separation helps attribute gains to the memory representation interface rather than to a jointly entangled agent policy.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the experimental emphasis is on whether task-conditioned view selection improves long-horizon decision making, not on raw storage capacity. The paper appears to provide two kinds of evidence: end-task gains and attribution studies showing that the gains come from working-memory construction rather than unrelated components. The training setup for Router—soft supervision followed by grouped GRPO—is already designed to isolate the effect of view selection.

The excerpt does not include full tables or final numbers, so the exact quantitative gains cannot be stated reliably here. Still, the intended comparisons are clear: fixed representations such as timelines, summaries, or flat retrieved snippets are contrasted with dynamically constructed relational views defined by relation type, evidence range, outcome filter, and granularity. The expectation is that dynamic views are better matched to subtasks like loop detection, state tracking, failure analysis, and dependency reasoning.

Another likely experimental point is the decision not to write temporary views back into persistent memory. The authors argue that writing them back would bake task-local bias into long-term memory and reduce future reuse. A meaningful ablation should therefore compare persistent event streams plus on-demand views against fixed summary memories or recursively compressed memories. When reading the experiments, the most useful things to look for are: whether Router’s chosen view distribution changes with task state, how large the gap is between fixed and dynamic views, and whether optical views help because they expose structure rather than merely saving tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and make sure the distinction between representation mismatch, storage failure, and retrieval failure is clear. That problem decomposition is the foundation of the whole paper. Without it, the method can look like another memory-engineering variant.

Then read the Method section with focus on the five-module pipeline, especially Router’s action space. Two questions matter: why should view selection be modeled explicitly instead of being left implicit inside the main policy prompt, and why should temporary working views never be written back into persistent memory? The first is about a learnable memory interface; the second is about preventing task-local bias from contaminating long-term memory.

Next, inspect the optical-view examples carefully. The important point is not just “history as images to save tokens.” The stronger claim is that 2D layout can expose relational structure directly. If the paper includes visual examples, they are worth reading closely because they reveal whether the method truly changes information organization or merely changes modality.

In the experiments, prioritize the training of the view policy, comparisons against fixed views, and ablations over relation types. A practical skim should take about 20–30 minutes. For a pretraining-oriented reader, the main takeaway is the interface question: how the same evidence can be exposed to a model in different structures depending on the decision context.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 memory ablation 即可；它把“存得多”改成“按任务重排”，比多数向量记忆论文更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and memory ablations; reframing memory as task-conditioned restructuring rather than storing more is cleaner than many vector-memory agent papers.

paper.title: Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable: Bounds on Representation Routing for Web Agents
paper.abstract: Web agents observe a browser through text, pixels, or both, and the choice is usually fixed once for all tasks. We measure six observation modes across eight site-model combinations (cells) on VisualWebArena and WebArena and ask what choosing per task would buy. The modes are complementary: each solves tasks the others miss, they fail in structurally different ways, and the best choice reverses between task sets. The obvious prize, an oracle that picks a winning mode for every task, looks large

summary.core_problem: 解决 web agent 中 observation mode（文本、像素或多模态）应否按任务动态路由，以及这种路由在真实噪声下是否真的值得学的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在提出更强 agent，而在把 web agent 常见的“按任务选表示”设想拆开测量，指出 oracle 增益常被运行噪声高估，并给出更现实的成本边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 VisualWebArena 和 WebArena 上系统比较六种 observation mode、八个 site-model 组合，先测模式互补性，再估计 per-task oracle 的理论收益，并显式量化 run-to-run noise。随后测试五种 routing policy，包括基于任务文本的零成本规则、confidence cascade 等，分析何时值得把任务送到更强但更贵的模式。
summary.experiments: 核心实验发现：同一 mode 在同一任务上重复运行会带来 12-14% 的结果变化，因此 naive oracle 对动态路由收益的估计偏乐观；在 8/8 个 cell 中，把只有当前 mode 解决不了的任务送到最便宜的补充 mode，可在成功率不变下节省 9.5-30.6% 成本。工作主要基于 WebArena/VisualWebArena，属于 agent 系统分析而非预训练实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UCL 与 Holistic AI。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether web agents should dynamically route between text, pixel, or multimodal observation modes per task, and whether such routing is actually learnable and worthwhile under realistic noise.
summary_en.importance: The value is not a stronger agent but a cleaner measurement study: it shows that oracle gains from per-task routing are often inflated by run-to-run variance, and derives a more realistic cost bound.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares six observation modes across eight site-model cells on VisualWebArena and WebArena, measuring complementarity, estimating per-task oracle gains, and explicitly quantifying run-to-run noise. It then evaluates five routing policies, including a zero-cost rule from task text and confidence cascades, to study when expensive modes are worth invoking.
summary_en.experiments: A key result is that rerunning the same mode on the same tasks changes outcomes by 12-14%, which makes naive oracle estimates overly optimistic. In all 8/8 cells, sending only tasks unsolved by one mode to the cheapest complementary mode reduces cost by 9.5-30.6% at unchanged success. This is an agent systems analysis, not a pretraining study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UCL and Holistic AI.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不直接，但它提醒一个常被忽略的坑：agent 路由收益很容易被评测噪声吹大；只看噪声分析和 cost bound 即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly about pretraining, but it nails an easy-to-miss issue: routing gains in agents are often overstated by evaluation noise; read the noise analysis and cost-bound sections only.

paper.title: EvoGUI: An Evolution-Aware Benchmark for GUI State-Transition Understanding
paper.abstract: GUI agents must reason about how actions transform interface states, but end-to-end success rates entangle this ability with perception, grounding, planning, and recovery. We introduce EvoGUI, a diagnostic framework that converts normalized GUI trajectories into three complementary visual question answering probes: temporal ordering, inverse action/value prediction, and contrastive one-step successor discrimination. Their labels are derived from trajectory order and logged actions, requiring no

summary.core_problem: GUI agent 的端到端成功率把感知/OCR/定位/规划/恢复等因素混在一起，难以单独诊断模型是否真正理解“动作如何改变界面状态”。该论文要解决的是：如何把已有 GUI 交互轨迹，低成本地转成专门测“状态转移理解（state-transition understanding）”的诊断题，并明确其反事实/可辨识性边界。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 VLM/多模态预训练与 agent 方向的评测很实用：它提供了一套可迁移的、从日志自动派生标签的 transition-level probes，用来衡量模型的局部世界模型能力（forward/inverse/dynamics discrimination）。这类诊断集能反向指导数据与训练目标：如果模型在 T2（逆向动作/值）或 T3（一步可达判别）系统性失败，说明需要更强的“动作—状态”配对数据、或在预训练/中训练加入更明确的时序与交互建模信号，而不是继续堆端到端 agent rollout。
summary.technical_approach:
EvoGUI 的核心是“轨迹规范化 + 三类 VQA 探针 + 机械派生标签”。
- 轨迹 schema：相邻截图 (s_t, s_{t+1})，记录动作 a_t（click/type/select）、可选值 v_t（输入文本/选项），以及元数据 m_t。不同数据源（Mind2Web、WebLINX）先做 schema normalization。
- T1 Temporal Ordering：从同一轨迹抽 K∈{3,4,5} 张截图打乱，让模型输出时间顺序，测时序结构理解。
- T2 Inverse Action/Value：给 (s_t, s_{t+1}) 预测动作类别；并提供更严格的 joint 版本，要求对 type/select 还原精确 value，避免模型只猜动作不管内容。
- T3 One-step Successor Discrimination：给当前状态与两个候选下一状态，让模型选日志中的真实相邻 successor。distractor 分三档：跨轨迹、同域、long-skip（同轨迹更后面的 s_{t+n}, n≥3）。作者明确：因为 distractor 来自日志采样而非执行验证的反事实，T3 测的是“在给定候选里识别相邻一步”，不是证明另一个候选在任何状态下都不可能一步到达。
- 质量控制：作者指出 GUI 截图可能有异步刷新/广告/加载等导致视觉歧义，因此有人审/过滤流程（全文后半应给出具体规则与一致性检查）。
summary.experiments:
EvoGUI-Bench 由 Mind2Web 与 WebLINX 构建，规模 3,000 instances，覆盖 120 domains。评测 28 个 VLM 配置的 zero-shot 表现。
关键结果：最强模型仅 60.4 EvoGain，整体远未饱和；并分析模型规模与 GUI 相关训练对分数的影响（摘要截断处暗示 scale 与 GUI 数据/训练会显著相关）。
从任务设计可预期的细粒度现象（通常会在全文分析里出现）：
- T2 joint（动作+值）显著难于 action-only，暴露“读懂输入框内容/选项文本并对齐到变化”的短板。
- T3 long-skip distractor 最具诊断性，因为它要求模型理解一步变化的局部性，而不是仅凭同域相似度匹配。
具体分项数字与各模型配置差异需要回看主表与分任务 breakdown。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先读 Benchmark 部分对三任务（T1/T2/T3）的形式化定义与 distractor 采样策略，这是这篇论文的“方法”。
- 重点看作者对标签可辨识性与反事实边界的声明（尤其是 T3 不保证不可达），这决定了如何正确解读分数。
- 看质量控制与歧义案例：GUI 里异步变化会让 transition 监督变脏，这部分对后续扩展到更多轨迹数据很关键。
- 最后扫实验主表：关注分任务表现差异，而不是只看总分 EvoGain；它更像诊断仪表盘。

summary_en.core_problem: End-to-end GUI agent success rates entangle perception, OCR, grounding, planning, and recovery, making it hard to isolate whether a model truly understands how actions transform interface states. The paper targets a scalable way to convert existing GUI trajectories into transition-level diagnostic questions with automatically derived labels, while being explicit about ambiguity and counterfactual limitations.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution rather than a new pretraining objective, but it is useful for foundation-model development in two ways: (1) it provides transition-level probes that better reflect “local world modeling” for GUI interaction (ordering, inverse dynamics, one-step successor discrimination); (2) it can feed back into data/recipe decisions—systematic failures on inverse action/value or one-step reachability suggest missing action-conditioned temporal supervision in pretraining or mid-training, not merely insufficient agent rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
EvoGUI consists of trajectory normalization plus three VQA-style diagnostics with mechanically derived labels.
- Normalized schema: consecutive screenshots (s_t, s_{t+1}), logged action a_t (click/type/select), optional value v_t (typed text/selected option), and metadata.
- T1 Temporal ordering: given K screenshots (K=3/4/5) from the same trajectory in shuffled order, predict the chronological order.
- T2 Inverse action/value: given (s_t, s_{t+1}), predict the action class; a stricter joint variant requires exact value recovery for type/select to prevent partial credit.
- T3 One-step successor discrimination: choose the logged adjacent successor among two candidates; distractors are sampled as cross-trajectory, same-domain, or long-skip (a later state s_{t+n}, n≥3) from the same trajectory. The paper explicitly notes that since distractors are log-sampled rather than execution-validated counterfactuals, T3 measures discrimination among provided candidates, not universal impossibility.
- Quality control: acknowledges GUI-specific ambiguity (async refresh, ads, loading) and applies manual filtering/validation steps (details are in the benchmark construction section).
summary_en.experiments:
EvoGUI-Bench is instantiated from Mind2Web and WebLINX with 3,000 instances across 120 domains. The authors evaluate 28 VLM configurations zero-shot.
Headline result: the best model reaches only 60.4 EvoGain, indicating the benchmark is far from saturated. The paper also studies how model scale and GUI-related training correlate with performance (the abstract suggests a notable dependence).
For practical reading, the most informative results are the per-task breakdowns: action-only vs joint action+value on T2, and the effect of distractor tiers (especially long-skip) on T3. Exact numbers require the main tables/appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the benchmark/task definitions carefully; T1/T2/T3 and distractor sampling are the core contribution.
- Pay attention to the stated limits (especially T3’s non-counterfactual nature) to avoid over-interpreting scores.
- Review the ambiguity/quality-control section; GUI transitions are noisy and this determines how transferable the pipeline is.
- Then scan the main results table and per-task breakdowns; treat EvoGain as a dashboard, not a single ranking.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和 28 模型结果就够；它给 GUI agent 评测补了一个比成功率更干净的中间变量。
recommendation.en: Read the probe design and the 28-model results; it adds a cleaner intermediate variable than end-to-end success for GUI agents.

paper.title: UNIBROWSE: A Data-to-Agent Framework for Multimodal BrowseComp
paper.abstract: Multimodal BrowseComp tasks require agents to combine perception, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning over dynamic web content, challenging their ability to handle compositional structure, open-world uncertainty, and multimodal integration across extended interactions. Crucially, real-world multimodal browsing involves three distinct information-flow patterns: text-only, image-to-text, and text-to-image, yet existing data construction methods cover only the text-only and image-to-text patterns,

summary.core_problem: UniBrowse 解决的是多模态 BrowseComp 训练数据覆盖不足的问题，尤其是现有方法偏重 text-only 和 image-to-text，缺少 text-to-image 这类先文本检索、再视觉验证或视觉定位的信息流。
summary.importance: 这篇不是基座预训练论文，主要价值在 post-train 数据合成和长程工具使用训练。对预训练研究的启发在于：复杂 agent 能力的训练信号不能只看最终 QA，对轨迹的可探索性、证据链结构、模态流向也需要显式建模。它把知识图谱的可控结构和实时网页证据结合，用来降低纯随机网页漫游的噪声，也避免只依赖静态图谱导致覆盖面窄。这个思路可迁移到更一般的 tool-use SFT/RL 数据构造：先控制任务骨架，再引入开放环境证据，最后按轨迹多样性过滤。
summary.technical_approach: UniBrowse 包含一个数据构造管线和一个由该数据训练出的多模态 browsing agent。管线从文本知识图谱出发，为 seed entity 构造连通的文本证据子图，并通过多跳关系扩展形成可组合的推理骨架。随后接入 live web retrieval，为图谱骨架补充真实网页证据，缓解纯图谱数据过于封闭的问题。任务被组织成三类信息流：text-only，即答案来自多段文本证据组合；image-to-text，即先解析图像线索，再通过文本浏览定位答案；text-to-image，即先通过文本证据确定目标，再进行图像搜索、视觉确认或视觉检索。训练数据选择上引入 exploration degree，用成功轨迹的多样性衡量样本是否提供足够的长程决策学习信号，并过滤低探索度样本。模型训练采用冷启动工具使用轨迹做 SFT，再进行 exploration-aware RL。
summary.experiments: 论文从管线生成 8K 条冷启动 tool-use trajectories 和 10K 个 QA pairs，并训练一个 35B 规模的 UniBrowse agent。实验声称该 agent 在多模态 BrowseComp benchmarks 上超过既有开源基线。提供内容中没有完整列出各 benchmark 的具体分数和消融表，但可以确认的实验主线是三部分：三种信息流覆盖带来的任务多样性，KG skeleton 加 live web retrieval 对证据可靠性和真实感的影响，以及 exploration degree 过滤对 RL 训练效率的影响。最值得关注的消融应是去掉 text-to-image、去掉 web augmentation、去掉 exploration-aware filtering 后的性能与训练效率变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 data construction pipeline 和 exploration degree 的定义，判断它是否只是启发式过滤，还是能稳定预测 RL 训练收益。Figure 2 应该能快速说明从 KG 到网页证据再到三类任务的生成流程。实验部分主要看三组消融：信息流覆盖、web retrieval 增强、exploration-aware data selection。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过 agent 部署细节；若关心 post-train 数据工程，这篇的样本选择标准值得记录。

summary_en.core_problem: UniBrowse addresses a data construction gap for multimodal BrowseComp agents: existing pipelines mostly cover text-only and image-to-text cases, while text-to-image workflows, where textual browsing determines what should later be visually searched or verified, remain underrepresented.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training data and agent-training paper rather than a base pretraining contribution. Its relevance comes from the way it structures training signals for long-horizon tool use. The paper treats browsing data not just as final QA pairs, but as trajectories with modality flow, evidence structure, and exploration diversity. The combination of a controllable knowledge-graph skeleton with live web retrieval is a useful design pattern: it avoids the narrowness of purely graph-based generation while reducing the noise of unconstrained web random walks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two parts: a data pipeline and a multimodal browsing agent trained on its output. Starting from a textual knowledge graph, UniBrowse builds connected evidence subgraphs around seed entities through multi-hop expansion. These graph-derived skeletons provide controllable reasoning paths. The pipeline then augments them with live web retrieval, adding open-web evidence and making the generated tasks closer to real browsing. It explicitly generates three information-flow patterns: text-only composition over textual evidence, image-to-text resolution from an initial visual clue into textual browsing, and text-to-image workflows where textual evidence guides later visual retrieval or verification. For data selection, the paper introduces exploration degree, a metric intended to capture the diversity of successful reasoning trajectories. Low-exploration instances are filtered out so that RL focuses on tasks with richer long-horizon decision signals. Training uses SFT on cold-start tool-use trajectories followed by exploration-aware RL.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline produces 8K cold-start tool-use trajectories and 10K QA pairs, which are used to train a 35B-scale UniBrowse agent. The reported result is stronger performance than prior open-source baselines on multimodal BrowseComp benchmarks. The provided content does not include full numeric tables, so the most important experimental claims are structural: coverage of all three modality-flow patterns, web-augmented grounding over KG skeletons, and exploration-degree filtering for more efficient RL. The most informative ablations to inspect are removal of text-to-image data, removal of live web augmentation, and removal of exploration-aware filtering.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should be sufficient. Read the data pipeline first, especially how graph skeletons are converted into web-grounded tasks and how the three flow patterns are instantiated. Then inspect the definition of exploration degree and the filtering procedure; the key question is whether it reliably predicts useful RL signal or only acts as a coarse heuristic. Figure 2 should give the fastest view of the generation pipeline. For base-model researchers, the agent implementation details are secondary; the data selection mechanism is the part worth retaining.

recommendation.zh: 只读数据生成和 exploration degree；若指标真能预测 RL 信号质量，值得迁移到内部 agent 数据筛选。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and exploration-degree metric; if it predicts RL signal quality, it is worth porting to internal agent-data filtering.

institutions: Key Laboratory of Computational Linguistics, MOE, Peking University

paper.title: DeepSearch-World: Self-Distillation for Deep Search Agents in a Verifiable Environment
paper.abstract: Training tool-use agents to improve from their own experience remains challenging, as supervised fine-tuning relies on fixed teacher-distilled trajectories, while sparse-reward reinforcement learning provides weak supervision for long-horizon interactions. We present DeepSearch-Evolve, a self-distillation framework for web agents built on DeepSearch-World, a deterministic and verifiable environment with reproducible search and page-reading tools. DeepSearch-World contains 420K multi-hop QA tasks

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是长程搜索型工具 Agent 的自我改进问题：SFT 只能模仿已有成功轨迹，容易被基座模型能力和轨迹多样性限制；RL 只有最终答案奖励，难以告诉模型是查询、读页、证据抽取还是答案合成出了问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对 post-train 与可验证环境构造有参考意义。它把 Agent 训练中的关键矛盾从“有没有更多轨迹”推进到“能不能获得可复现、可验证的过程监督”。这类环境和数据闭环会影响未来 tool-use / search agent 的 SFT、RL 和自蒸馏 recipe，尤其是如何在不依赖强闭源教师模型的情况下扩展训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了 DeepSearch-World，一个基于 Wikipedia 的离线确定性搜索环境，包含 search 和 page-reading 工具，以及 420K 个通过实体级随机游走构造的多跳 QA 任务。确定性环境的作用是让同一个查询、同一个页面读取动作产生可复现观察，避免 live web 或 LLM simulator 带来的噪声。DeepSearch-Evolve 在这个环境上做迭代式自蒸馏：先由教师策略生成带 scaffold 的轨迹，显式记录计划、进度、证据、失败尝试、反思和恢复；再用验证信号筛选成功轨迹；随后把 scaffold 轨迹转成标准 ReAct 格式，让学生模型学习可执行的 tool-use 行为；最后循环生成、筛选、混合和 SFT 更新。与普通 self-training 的区别在于，它不是只保留最终正确答案轨迹，而是利用环境验证把中间搜索过程也变成训练信号。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 DeepSearch-World-9B 在开放模型搜索 Agent 中达到有竞争力的表现，且没有依赖强闭源模型蒸馏。分析显示，模型能维持更长的工具交互，工具调用更有效，并从两个关键设计中获益：一是基于验证信号的轨迹过滤，减少错误行为进入训练集；二是 scaffold-to-ReAct 转换，把带有显式状态和反思的教师轨迹压缩成学生可学习的标准交互格式。给出的全文片段中没有包含完整 benchmark 名称、分数表和消融数字，因此不宜补充具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 DeepSearch-World 的任务生成、工具接口和验证信号设计，以及 DeepSearch-Evolve 的四步训练循环。实验部分优先看轨迹过滤、scaffold-to-ReAct、数据混合和迭代轮次相关消融。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过大部分 Agent benchmark 细节，保留对“可验证环境如何产生过程监督”的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets self-improvement for long-horizon search agents. SFT on successful traces quickly saturates, while sparse RL rewards do not identify whether failures come from query formulation, tool choice, evidence extraction, or final answer synthesis.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is to post-training rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is the training-signal design: a deterministic and verifiable environment can turn agent rollouts into process-level supervision, not just final-answer labels. This matters for tool-use training recipes that aim to scale without relying on stronger proprietary teacher models.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepSearch-World is an offline Wikipedia-grounded environment with reproducible search and page-reading tools. It contains 420K multi-hop QA tasks built from entity-level random walks. The deterministic setup makes intermediate actions verifiable, which is hard to obtain from live web environments or LLM-based simulators. DeepSearch-Evolve then performs iterative self-distillation: a teacher policy generates scaffolded trajectories with planning, progress tracking, evidence, failed attempts, reflection, and recovery; verification signals filter the trajectories; the scaffolded traces are converted into standard ReAct-format supervision; the student is updated with SFT and used for the next round. The key difference from ordinary self-training is that the environment exposes dense behavioral supervision over tool-use decisions, rather than only accepting or rejecting final answers.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that DeepSearch-World-9B is competitive among open-source search agents without distillation from stronger proprietary models. The analyses indicate longer tool-use interactions, more effective tool usage, and gains from verified trajectory filtering and scaffold-to-ReAct conversion. The provided full-text content does not include the complete benchmark tables or numeric deltas, so exact score improvements should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the environment construction, the verification mechanism, and the DeepSearch-Evolve training loop. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on trajectory filtering, scaffold-to-ReAct conversion, data mixing, and iterative updates. Readers focused on base-model research can skip most benchmark details and retain the design pattern for creating verifiable process supervision.

recommendation.zh: 读环境构造和过滤准则即可；它对预训练的价值在于展示“可验证经验池”怎样替代昂贵教师轨迹。
recommendation.en: Read the environment construction and filtering rules; the useful signal is how a verifiable experience pool can replace expensive teacher trajectories.

summary.core_problem: 解决单个 ReAct 式网页搜索 agent 在复杂深度研究任务中同时兼顾搜索深度、覆盖面和证据组织能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 web agent 编排方法，而不是预训练工作；价值主要在于展示递归委派和多 agent 协作如何改善长链搜索任务，对研究 test-time scaling、agentic inference 和工具使用有间接参考意义。

summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，论文主打 deep-and-wide web search 场景，对比对象应包括单 agent ReAct 和已有并行多 agent 搜索系统，重点考察复杂研究型任务中的覆盖率、深度和证据支撑质量。摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据规模和具体增益数字，因此目前更适合作为方法思路参考，而非可直接迁移的 clean empirical evidence。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院与快手。Ji-Rong Wen 是信息检索与搜索方向的知名学者，这使论文在 web search 任务设定上有一定可信度，但其核心仍偏 agent 系统而非基座模型。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inability of a single ReAct-style web-search agent to jointly achieve depth, breadth, and evidence organization on complex research-oriented search tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a general web-agent orchestration paper rather than a pretraining paper; its value is mainly in showing how recursive delegation and multi-agent collaboration improve long-horizon search, which is indirectly relevant to test-time scaling and agentic inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes WebSwarm, a recursive multi-agent orchestration framework. It represents the task as dynamically expanded search nodes, each with a local objective and a search mode. A node can solve the objective itself or delegate to child nodes, while the system jointly performs decomposition, recursive expansion, collaboration, and evidence aggregation during inference.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the target setting is deep-and-wide web search, likely compared against single-agent ReAct baselines and prior parallel multi-agent search systems. The focus appears to be coverage, depth, and evidence-groundedness on complex research tasks. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or concrete gains, so it is more useful as a systems idea than as clean empirical evidence for foundation-model research.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Renmin University of China and Kuaishou. Ji-Rong Wen is a well-known researcher in information retrieval and search, which adds credibility to the task setup, though the work is still primarily an agent systems paper rather than a foundation-model paper.

recommendation.zh: 偏 agent 编排，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；若关心 test-time scaling，只看递归委派设计和失败模式，别花太多时间在任务包装上。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent orchestration, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you care about test-time scaling, read the recursive delegation design and failure analysis, not the task packaging.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Prismata: Confining Cross-Site Prompt Injection in Web Agents

The core challenge is that deriving a task-specific security policy requires reasoning over page structure

summary.core_problem: 自主Web Agent存在跨站提示注入风险，第三方内容可劫持Agent，而现有方法难以区分页面中可信与不可信内容的权限边界。
summary.importance: 提出针对Web Agent的上下文最小权限防御框架Prismata，结合经典完整性模型实现结构与机械双重约束，属于Agent安全领域的方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 通过动态信任推导为页面内容生成权限标签（错误仅降权的结构约束保证），并通过机械约束执行权限，限制Agent的可见内容与可执行操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验设置与效果数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Autonomous web agents face cross-site prompt injection risks where third-party content can hijack the agent, and existing methods struggle to distinguish permission boundaries between trusted and untrusted page content.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Prismata, a contextual least-privilege defense framework for web agents, combining structural and mechanical constraints inspired by classical integrity models, contributing to agent security methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generates permission labels for page content via dynamic trust derivation (with structural guarantee that labeling errors only reduce privilege), and enforces permissions via mechanical confinement to limit agent visibility and actions.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup and performance data are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: Web Agent安全的系统级防御方案，与基座预训练关联弱，仅需了解权限约束思路即可。
recommendation.en: System-level defense for web agent security, weak relevance to base pretraining; only the privilege constraint idea is worth noting.

paper.title: Making Failure Safe: A Constrained, Verifiable Agent Framework for Open-Web Data Collection
paper.abstract: LLMs and agents can generate web scrapers from natural-language requirements, but direct generation remains unreliable because of dependency errors, broken selectors, schema mismatches, and heterogeneous page structures. We propose a constrained, verifiable agent framework that shifts LLM output from free-form code to typed JSON collector configurations, combining a six-type collector taxonomy, template and utility-function constraints, static Airflow DAG execution, rule-based quality checking,

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM直接生成网页数据采集器时存在的依赖错误、选择器失效、Schema不匹配等可靠性不足问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出约束式可验证Agent框架，将自由代码生成转为结构化配置生成，提升web数据采集的确定性与可验证性
summary.technical_approach: 设计六类采集器分类体系，将LLM输出从自由形式代码约束为类型化JSON采集配置，结合模板与效用函数约束、静态Airflow DAG执行、规则化质量检查和结构化反馈修正，实现执行阶段零LLM token调用的确定性运行
summary.experiments: 在138个任务上验证分类体系可支持需求类型化；在80个独立源验证任务上，实现执行阶段零LLM token，平均运行时间最低，以单次生成质量的适度下降换取可复用、确定性、可验证的执行路径

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the unreliability of LLM-generated web data collectors, including dependency errors, broken selectors, schema mismatches, and heterogeneous page structures
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a constrained verifiable agent framework that shifts from free-form code generation to structured configuration generation, improving determinism and verifiability of web data collection
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a six-type collector taxonomy, constrains LLM output to typed JSON collector configurations instead of free-form code, combined with template/utility constraints, static Airflow DAG execution, rule-based quality checking, and structured feedback correction for deterministic execution with zero LLM tokens at runtime

recommendation.zh: 面向网页数据采集的约束式Agent框架，思路对预训练数据爬取工具开发有参考，属于增量改进，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: A constrained agent framework for web data collection, useful for pre-training data crawling tool development as an incremental improvement; read abstract only

paper.title: Decoupling Reconnaissance and Exploitation: Measuring the Capability Boundaries of LLM-Based Web Penetration Testing
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for automated penetration testing, yet existing end-to-end black-box evaluations are highly susceptible to error cascading: failures in early reconnaissance can mask an agent's actual ability to exploit vulnerabilities. To more accurately characterize these capabilities, we propose a two-stage decoupled evaluation framework that separates exploit execution from reconnaissance. Using ground-truth injection and knowledge-driven ablation across 70 hig

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决 LLM Web 渗透测试 agent 的评测归因问题：端到端黑盒评测会把侦察阶段的失败传导到漏洞利用阶段，使研究者无法区分 agent 是不会发现漏洞，还是发现后不会利用漏洞。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接价值有限，更接近 agent eval 和工具使用评测。但它有一个可迁移的评测思想：把复杂 agent 任务拆成感知、状态构建、执行几个可控阶段，用 ground-truth injection 隔离错误来源。这个思路对代码 agent、浏览器 agent、长程工具调用评测也有参考意义，尤其适合诊断模型能力和系统编排能力之间的边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是两阶段解耦评测。第一阶段评估自主侦察能力，关注 agent 能否从页面、日志、工具输出和异常信息中定位目标漏洞。第二阶段在侦察失败时注入标准化的真实漏洞上下文，让 agent 在已知漏洞位置和类型的条件下执行利用，从而单独测量 exploitation 能力。作者还做 knowledge-driven ablation，用不同程度的先验信息观察性能变化。评测资产来自 Vulhub 和 Vulfocus，重建了 70 个高保真 Web 漏洞环境，并选取 50 个代表性漏洞进行严格对齐比较。被测对象包括 5 个开源渗透测试 agent，覆盖 multi-agent、monolithic 和 graph-driven 架构。
summary.experiments: 核心结果是侦察和利用之间存在明显断层。在注入准确漏洞上下文后，agent 的 Functional Success Rate 最高达到 90.0%；但在自主侦察条件下，Targeted Vulnerability Recall 大约停在 50.0%。主要失败来源不是简单的 payload 生成，而是对非结构化环境反馈的解析不足，例如错误页面、工具 telemetry、WAF 拦截信息和非标准返回。架构分析显示，不同 agent 有不同适用区间：multi-agent 隔离更适合反序列化这类长交互链路；monolithic 架构在短链注入上更直接；graph-driven 设计在跨 session 的访问控制漏洞上表现更好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看第 3 节的两阶段评测协议和 ground-truth injection 设计，再看第 4 节的 benchmark 构建、指标定义和总体结果。第 5 节的架构归因值得快速扫一遍，重点关注 multi-agent、monolithic、graph-driven 的失败模式差异。若只关心通用 agent 评测，可跳过具体漏洞细节，保留“阶段解耦 + 真实状态注入 + 错误归因”的评测框架。
summary.authors_note: 材料中可确认的机构包括南京理工大学、Runjian Co., Ltd. 的研究机构，以及与中国科学技术大学邮箱相关的作者信息；作者列表未完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses attribution in LLM-based web penetration-testing agents. In end-to-end black-box evaluation, a failed reconnaissance step can hide whether the agent is actually incapable of exploitation or simply never reached the right vulnerability context.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the evaluation idea is useful for general agent research. It separates perception, state construction, and execution so that failure sources can be measured rather than inferred. The same design pattern can be applied to coding agents, browser agents, and long-horizon tool-use systems where early observation errors often mask downstream capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation protocol decouples reconnaissance from exploitation. First, agents attempt autonomous reconnaissance and are measured on whether they can identify the target vulnerability from pages, logs, tool outputs, and noisy runtime feedback. If reconnaissance fails, the framework injects ground-truth vulnerability context and then measures exploitation under controlled conditions. The authors also use knowledge-driven ablations to vary the amount of prior information. The benchmark contains 70 reconstructed high-fidelity web vulnerability environments from Vulhub and Vulfocus, with a strictly aligned subset of 50 representative vulnerabilities. Five open-source penetration-testing agents are evaluated, covering multi-agent, monolithic, and graph-driven designs.
summary_en.experiments: The main finding is a large gap between exploitation and reconnaissance. With accurate vulnerability context, agents reach a Functional Success Rate of up to 90.0%. Under autonomous reconnaissance, Targeted Vulnerability Recall plateaus around 50.0%. The dominant failures come from parsing unstructured telemetry and unstable environment feedback, including non-standard error messages, WAF interference, and noisy tool outputs. The architecture analysis identifies different niches: multi-agent isolation helps with long interaction chains such as deserialization; monolithic agents do better on short-chain injections; graph-driven agents are stronger on cross-session access-control vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is sufficient. Focus on the two-stage protocol and ground-truth injection design, then read the benchmark construction, metric definitions, and aggregate results. The architecture attribution section is useful for understanding how control-flow design changes failure modes. Readers interested mainly in general agent evaluation can skip most vulnerability-specific details and retain the broader recipe: stage decomposition, controlled state injection, and explicit error attribution.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided material identifies Nanjing University of Science and Technology, a research institute of Runjian Co., Ltd., and author contact information associated with the University of Science and Technology of China. The full author list is not available in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是安全应用本身，而是把 agent 失败拆干净了；做 tool-use 或 web agent 的人应直接借它的解耦评测思路，重点看 ablation 设计。
recommendation.en: This is useful not as a security application but as a cleaner failure decomposition for agents; if you work on tool use or web agents, borrow the decoupled evaluation design and read the ablations.

paper.title: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
paper.abstract: Long-horizon web agents often fail in ways hidden by final-answer evaluation: they may visit useful pages, produce a well-formed answer, and terminate confidently while still missing fields, over-including unsupported items, or relying on stale evidence. We study these failures with Parallel WebBench, a parallel web-exploration benchmark containing 1,679 verified records: 350 manually curated parallel tasks and 1,329 reconstructed records with verified URL-based trajectories. We train WebExplore

summary.core_problem: 长程Web智能体在并行多子目标探索任务中存在「完成率-正确率鸿沟」——即使输出格式合规、自信终止，仍会出现字段缺失、冗余信息、证据过时等隐性失败，现有基准和仅看最终答案的完成率指标无法捕捉这类可靠性缺陷。
summary.importance: 该工作揭示了agent训练中的RL优化（如GRPO）和合成数据会大幅抬高表面完成率，但无法解决核心可靠性问题；提出的细粒度评测（元素级F1）和轨迹级诊断方法，可用于设计更精准的agent训练目标与奖励函数，避免模型在无意义的完成信号上出现奖励投机。
summary.technical_approach: 1）定义并行Web探索任务设定（需从多页面收集多字段信息并结构化输出）；2）构建Parallel WebBench基准：包含350条人工校验的并行任务、1329条自动重构（校验活链、修复路径）的带URL轨迹记录，共1679条；3）识别三类可复现失败触发点：规范短语搜索循环、列表类问题提前终止、多行结构化输出的合成坍缩；4）设计轨迹级诊断工具，包括冗余搜索检测、轮次使用分析、元素召回统计、证据-答案绑定检查；5）用GRPO训练WebExplorer风格agent，对比纯人工、人-合成平衡、合成主导三种数据配比，以及精确匹配/部分信用两类奖励设计。
summary.experiments: 在16k上下文、16轮交互设定下，最优GRPO模型相比WebExplorer-8B基线，完成率从50.7%提升至96.0%，GPT-4.1-mini判定的元素级F1从0.2489提升至0.4529；但二元准确率（全结构化答案完全正确）仍远低于完成率，增加推理预算也不会单调提升正确率；轨迹诊断显示，模型常更自信地终止任务，但并未完全解决所有子问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计15-20分钟；重点关注基准构建的人工+自动校验流程、三类失败模式的定义与诊断方法、GRPO不同数据配比的性能对比表、奖励信号稀疏性分析部分；无需深究具体任务示例的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon web agents exhibit a completion-correctness gap in parallel multi-subgoal exploration tasks: they produce well-formed final answers and terminate confidently, but still suffer from hidden failures including missing fields, unsupported over-inclusion, and stale evidence. Existing benchmarks and final-answer-only completion metrics fail to capture these reliability gaps.
summary_en.importance: This work reveals that RL optimization (e.g., GRPO) and synthetic data for agent training can inflate surface completion rates without resolving core reliability issues. The proposed fine-grained evaluation (element-wise F1) and trace-level diagnostics provide actionable signals for designing better agent training objectives and reward functions, avoiding reward hacking on trivial completion signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Define the parallel web exploration setting, where agents must collect multi-field information from multiple subpages and output structured results; 2) Build Parallel WebBench with 1,679 verified records: 350 manually curated parallel tasks plus 1,329 automatically reconstructed records with validated URL trajectories (live link check, path repair); 3) Identify three reproducible failure triggers: canonical-phrase search loops, premature termination on list-valued questions, and synthesis collapse in multi-row structured outputs; 4) Design trace diagnostics including redundant search detectors, round usage analysis, element-level recall, and evidence-to-answer binding checks; 5) Train WebExplorer-style agents with GRPO under three data mixtures (human-only, balanced human-synthetic, synthetic-heavy) and compare exact-match vs partial-credit reward designs.
summary_en.experiments: Under 16k context and 16 interaction rounds, the best GRPO model improves completion rate from 50.7% to 96.0% over the WebExplorer-8B baseline, and GPT-4.1-mini judged element-wise F1 from 0.2489 to 0.4529. However, binary accuracy (full structured answer correctness) remains far lower than completion rate; increasing inference budget does not monotonically improve correctness. Trace diagnostics show agents often terminate more confidently without fully solving all subproblems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, 15-20 minutes expected. Focus on the manual + automated benchmark curation pipeline, definitions and diagnostics of three failure modes, performance comparison tables across GRPO data mixtures, and reward sparsity analysis. Skip granular task examples unless working on web agent benchmark design.

recommendation.zh: Parallel WebBench解决了Web Agent评测的「假阳性完成」问题，GRPO数据混合的实验对后训练数据配比有参考价值，重点看§4失效模式分析和Table 2。
recommendation.en: Parallel WebBench addresses the "false positive completion" problem in web agent evaluation; the GRPO data mixture experiments are informative for post-training data ratio design, focus on §4 failure mode analysis and Table 2.

paper.title: MIRAGE: Stealthy Visual Prompt Injection for Vulnerability Detection in Web Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based web agents provide practical, high-precision solutions for visual browser automation; however, they inherently expand the attack surface, introducing novel vision-based vulnerabilities. Existing adversarial evaluations targeting these agents frequently rely on permissive threat models and visually conspicuous artifacts. In this paper, we investigate a constrained vulnerability detection setting: a trusted web platform where the evaluator acts solely a

summary.core_problem: 在“可信网站 + 第三方仅能控制页面局部合法区域（如广告位）”的现实威胁模型下，如何对基于截图的 MLLM web agent 进行隐蔽的视觉间接提示注入，实现对下一步动作文本的定向劫持。
summary.importance: 与 LLM 基座预训练关系较弱，核心是安全评测/攻击方法，主要贡献在 web agent 的视觉攻击面与更严格的 threat model。对预训练研究的间接启发是：1）多模态统一建模把渲染像素纳入上下文后，prompt injection 的边界从“文本/DOM”扩展到“视觉 token/像素”；2）扩散先验用于约束对抗补丁的自然性，提示生成式先验可作为攻击与防御的共同工具。但它不提供预训练数据、训练动态或 scaling 方面的直接结论。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 MIRAGE：在攻击者可控 mask 内进行优化，联合两类信号。
- diffusion-guided patch：用扩散模型先验在局部区域合成“看起来合理”的内容，避免明显的对抗噪声；优化在虚拟 screenshot 空间中进行，最终与原图按 mask 合成。
- sparse residual perturbation：在少量视觉上不显眼（文中提到 dark-pixel）的像素上叠加稀疏残差，增强对目标 next-action 文本的控制力。
- curvature loss：为扩散采样/优化引入曲率相关损失以缓解局部最小值、扩大搜索。
- 以替代（surrogate）的视觉语言 web agent 为目标，使用定向 next-action objective 做梯度引导；由于不改 DOM，攻击聚焦在 action generation 阶段（而非 grounding）。
summary.experiments: 在 SeeAct 与 OpenClaw 上做系统评估，覆盖多个开源 MLLM web-agent 后端，并与现有 screenshot/text-based 攻击基线对比，结论是 MIRAGE 在严格空间约束与视觉自然性约束下仍能实现有效的 targeted next-action hijacking。给定内容片段未包含具体成功率/ASR 数字与可视化案例细节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（15–25 分钟）：
- 重点看 threat model 定义与约束条件：攻击者能控制什么、不能控制什么，这决定了方法是否贴近真实部署。
- 看方法部分的三块：mask 合成流程、扩散先验如何嵌入优化、稀疏残差与 curvature loss 的作用。
- 实验部分主要看：跨后端泛化、与基线的对比设置是否公平、是否有人类可感知性评估。
如果关注的是预训练，只需把它当作“多模态上下文带来的新攻击面”案例即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Under a realistic web-agent threat model where the platform is trusted and an attacker can only control a small, legitimate on-page visual region (e.g., an ad slot), how can one perform stealthy visual prompt injection to hijack an MLLM-based agent’s next-action generation toward a targeted instruction?
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a security/robustness paper rather than a pretraining one. Its indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining is that multimodal agents expand the prompt-injection boundary from text/DOM to rendered pixels, and that generative priors (diffusion) can be used to keep adversarial content natural-looking—an idea that matters for both attacks and defenses. It does not contribute directly to data mixture, scaling laws, optimization, or training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MIRAGE is a masked, diffusion-guided visual indirect prompt injection framework:
- Constrained editing: all modifications are restricted to an attacker-controlled mask and composited back into the screenshot.
- Diffusion prior: a diffusion model is used to synthesize locally plausible content within the mask, avoiding conspicuous adversarial artifacts.
- Sparse residuals: add sparse perturbations on visually inconspicuous pixels (notably dark pixels) to strengthen targeted control under tight spatial budget.
- Curvature loss: an additional loss term intended to escape poor local minima and broaden the search during diffusion sampling.
- Optimization is guided by a targeted next-action objective on a surrogate VLM web agent; since DOM is unchanged, the attack focuses on the action-generation stage rather than grounding.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on SeeAct and OpenClaw, across multiple open-source MLLM web-agent backends, and compared against prior screenshot-level and text-based attack baselines. The reported takeaway is that MIRAGE achieves effective targeted next-action hijacking while staying within strict spatial and plausibility constraints. The provided excerpt does not include concrete ASR numbers or detailed ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (15–25 minutes):
- Read the threat model carefully; it is the main novelty (bounded, legitimate region control).
- In the method, focus on how diffusion is integrated into the constrained optimization, and what the sparse residual + curvature loss add beyond a pure diffusion patch.
- In experiments, check cross-backend transfer and whether “stealthiness” is evaluated (human perceptibility, artifact metrics).
For pretraining-focused readers, treat it as an example of new multimodal attack surfaces rather than a training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 威胁模型收紧得比较干净：只控广告位还能劫持next-action，这对“视觉token进LM”的agent安全是硬问题；读清 threat model 与成功率表即可。
recommendation.en: A cleaner, more realistic threat model (ad-slot-only control) that still hijacks next actions—worth skimming for the threat model + success-rate tables; it’s a real safety issue for vision-token web agents.

paper.title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) web agents are usually deployed as tool callers: each turn, the model reads a fresh page observation and emits one structured tool action. When every action is a low-level primitive, horizons grow quickly and so do policy-facing LLM completions, dominating latency and cost on benchmarks such as Mind2Web and WebArena. Recent systems therefore wrap repeated interaction fragments as web skills: callable tools built from successful trajectories or induced programs, so one

summary.core_problem: 解决现有Web Agent技能库依赖指令/站点元数据匹配，导致跨未见站点技能复用率低、步骤与token开销大的问题
summary.importance: 通用Web Agent方法创新：提出基于页面布局结构匹配的跨站点技能迁移范式，提升技能复用率并降低推理成本
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillMigrator框架：1）从成功轨迹中诱导出可迁移的交互模式（技能），存储为布局结构-动作的映射；2）跨站点匹配时基于DOM布局结构而非指令语义或站点元数据，触发对应技能执行，替代多步低阶工具调用
summary.experiments: 在Mind2Web、WebArena等Web Agent基准上测试，SkillMigrator的跨站点技能复用率显著高于基于指令/元数据匹配的基线，步骤数与token开销大幅降低

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the low cross-unseen-site skill reuse rate and high step/token cost of existing Web Agent skill libraries relying on instruction/site metadata matching
summary_en.importance: General Web Agent method innovation: proposes a cross-site skill transfer paradigm based on page layout structure matching, improving skill reuse rate and reducing inference cost
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SkillMigrator framework: 1) induces transferable interaction patterns (skills) from successful trajectories, stored as layout structure-action mappings; 2) triggers skills via DOM layout structure matching instead of instruction semantics or site metadata, replacing multi-step low-level tool calls
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Mind2Web, WebArena benchmarks; SkillMigrator achieves significantly higher cross-site skill reuse rate than instruction/metadata matching baselines, with greatly reduced step count and token cost

recommendation.zh: Web Agent技能迁移的增量改进，仅需了解布局结构匹配比语义匹配更适合跨站点技能复用这一结论即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement of Web Agent skill transfer, only need to grasp that layout structure matching outperforms semantic matching for cross-site skill reuse

paper.title: StepGuard: Guarding Web Navigation via Single-Step Calibration
paper.abstract: Web navigation requires agents to follow natural language goals, interact with web pages, and produce accurate answers. While recent advances leverage vision-language models and reinforcement learning, existing methods still suffer from single-step fragility due to reward misalignment and error propagation. To tackle the reward entanglement, we design Dynamic Dual-Policy Optimization (DDPO), which dynamically switches between a navigation-first mode for exploration and an answer-first mode for q

summary.core_problem: 缓解 Web navigation agent 中单步动作错误、奖励冲突和错误传播导致的任务失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Web agent 训练与执行框架改进。它关注导航和最终回答之间的 reward entanglement，并用单步置信度触发反思修正。对通用 agent 后训练有一定参考价值，但不是基座预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: StepGuard 包含两个主要组件。Dynamic Dual-Policy Optimization 在 navigation-first 和 answer-first 两种模式之间动态切换，减少探索导航和最终问答目标之间的奖励冲突。Confidence-Guided Adaptive Navigation Reflection 估计每一步动作置信度，只在低置信或风险较高时触发反思，并用 contrastive rewards 鼓励自我修正，从而校准单步错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要称实验显示 StepGuard 改善 Web navigation 表现，但未给出 benchmark 名称、模型规模、RL 训练细节、baseline 或具体提升幅度。需要关注单步置信度是否真实预测失败，以及反思调用带来的额外 token 和环境交互成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce single-step fragility, reward conflict, and error propagation in web navigation agents.
summary_en.importance: This is a web-agent training and control contribution. It studies reward entanglement between navigation and final answering, plus confidence-triggered reflection for action correction. It is relevant to agent post-training but not directly to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: StepGuard introduces Dynamic Dual-Policy Optimization, which switches between navigation-first and answer-first modes to reduce reward conflict, and Confidence-Guided Adaptive Navigation Reflection, which estimates per-step confidence, triggers reflection only when needed, and uses contrastive rewards to encourage self-correction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that experiments show improved web navigation performance, but does not list benchmarks, model sizes, RL details, baselines, or numerical gains. The critical checks are whether confidence predicts failure and whether the gains survive accounting for extra reflection calls and environment interactions.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 分解和置信度校准消融；web agent 论文若不报交互成本，结论要打折。
recommendation.en: Only inspect reward decomposition and confidence-calibration ablations; web-agent claims need interaction-cost accounting.

paper.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench,

summary.core_problem: 现有 computer-use agent benchmark 在非个人环境中评估模型，无法测试需要登录或个人信息的真实 web 任务，与实际部署存在差距
summary.importance: 提出了首个面向个人智能计算机使用 agent 的 benchmark（MyPCBench），填补了评估与部署之间的 gap；Ruslan Salakhutdinov 团队出品
summary.technical_approach: 在 Linux 桌面构建 17 个模拟真实世界 web 应用和完整桌面栈，以《办公室》Michael Scott 为标准人设，定义 184 个来自 OpenClaw 社区的真实任务
summary.experiments: 测试 6 个闭源和开源模型，统一 computer+bash 工具界面；Claude Opus 4.6 最佳，完成 55.4% 任务
summary.authors_note: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov；Carnegie Mellon University；Ruslan Salakhutdinov 是深度学习和贝叶斯深度学习知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Current computer-use agent benchmarks evaluate in impersonal environments, cannot test web tasks requiring login or personal information — a gap between evaluation and real deployment
summary_en.importance: First benchmark (MyPCBench) for personally intelligent computer-use agents, filling the evaluation-deployment gap; from Ruslan Salakhutdinov's group at CMU
summary_en.technical_approach: Linux desktop with 17 simulated real-world web apps and full desktop stack, seeded for canonical persona (Michael Scott from The Office); 184 tasks inspired by real requests from OpenClaw community
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarked 6 closed and open-weight models with uniform computer+bash tool surface; Claude Opus 4.6 solves 55.4% of tasks as best performer
summary_en.authors_note: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov; Carnegie Mellon University; Ruslan Salakhutdinov is a prominent researcher in deep learning and Bayesian deep learning

recommendation.zh: CMU Salakhutdinov 团队的重要 benchmark 贡献，关注 agent 评测方向的读者应看任务设计和模拟环境搭建，对预训练研究员主要是评估设计有间接启发
recommendation.en: Important benchmark contribution from CMU Salakhutdinov's group; agent evaluation researchers should study task design and simulation setup; indirect inspiration for pretraining researchers on evaluation design

paper.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
paper.abstract: As autonomous web agents are increasingly deployed to perform real-world tasks, ensuring their safety has become a critical concern. In this work, we study web agent behavior under realistic deceptive interfaces in the e-commerce domain. We introduce WebDecept, a lightweight and configurable plugin framework that enables controlled injection of deceptive interface patterns into existing web environments. Using WebDecept, we instantiate seven deceptive patterns commonly observed on the open web,

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态 Web Agent 在电商页面的欺骗性界面模式下是否会偏离用户目标或违反安全约束。
summary.importance: 这是 Web Agent 安全评测资产。它把广告诱导、域名跳转、购物操控等真实网页中的 deceptive pattern 注入现有环境，用于可控地测量 agent 对 UI 欺骗的鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 WebDecept，一个轻量、可配置的插件框架，在任务执行时从前端注入欺骗性界面元素。它不是训练方法，而是构造可控干预环境，比较不同 deceptive pattern 对 agent 行为的影响，并测试 prompt 约束的缓解效果。
summary.experiments: 作者实例化 7 类常见欺骗模式，包括 targeted advertisements、domain redirection 和 shopping manipulation，并在多个多模态 Web Agent 上做 controlled evaluation。结果表明当前 Web Agent 对多类欺骗界面较敏感，单靠 prompt-based constraints 往往不能稳定避免失败。摘要未给出具体 agent 名称和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 AAII、University of Technology Sydney 和 University of Liverpool。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal web agents remain safe and goal-consistent when exposed to deceptive e-commerce interfaces.
summary_en.importance: This is a web-agent safety benchmark contribution. It provides a controlled way to inject realistic deceptive UI patterns, such as targeted ads, domain redirects, and shopping manipulation, into existing web environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce WebDecept, a lightweight configurable plugin that modifies the frontend during agent execution. The work focuses on controlled evaluation rather than agent training, measuring how different deceptive patterns affect behavior and whether prompt-level constraints mitigate failures.
summary_en.experiments: WebDecept instantiates seven common deceptive patterns and evaluates multiple multimodal web agents. The reported finding is that current web agents are susceptible to several classes of deceptive interfaces, and prompt-based constraints are often insufficient. The abstract does not provide detailed model names or numeric scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are AAII, University of Technology Sydney, and University of Liverpool.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Web agent 安全评测备查即可；读 deceptive pattern 设计，不必细读结果表。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a web-agent safety benchmark reference; read the deceptive-pattern design, not the full result tables.

institutions: AAII, University of Technology Sydney, NSW

paper.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
paper.abstract: Deep search requires agents to answer complex questions through multi-step web search, browsing, evidence comparison, and synthesis. A central challenge is deciding how to search when several directions look plausible but only some will later lead to reliable evidence. If an agent greedily follows the current best-looking direction, it may keep extending a weak continuation. If it explores without discipline, it may waste budget on disconnected trials. We propose TreeSeeker, an inference-time fr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 deep search agent 在多条看似合理搜索方向之间如何分配预算的问题，避免贪心延伸错误分支，也避免无约束探索浪费搜索成本。
summary.importance: 贡献是 inference-time agent search 框架，而不是基座模型训练。对通用 agent 系统有一定方法价值，尤其是把 trial-error-return 显式树化并加入不确定性控制。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 TreeSeeker，把搜索过程组织成树结构状态上的 branch-and-return 搜索。系统在每轮读取所有子目标树，用文本化 UCB 信号综合价值、不确定性和风险，在 exploitation、exploration、pruning 与 return 之间做选择。核心是让 agent 能在深搜索中回退到早期分叉点，而不是线性地一路走到底。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模。任务是复杂问题的多步 web search、浏览、证据比较与综合。主要对比对象应是贪心式或无结构搜索 agent。论文声称树化 trial-and-error 能更好控制预算并提高可靠证据发现率，但具体增益幅度需看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含微软研究团队常见作者 Qingwei Lin、Dongmei Zhang，若属实则更偏系统型 agent 研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles budget allocation in deep-search agents when multiple search directions look plausible, aiming to avoid both greedy overcommitment and undisciplined exploration.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-time agent search framework rather than foundation-model training. The main value is making trial-error-return explicit in a tree structure with uncertainty-aware control.
summary_en.technical_approach: TreeSeeker organizes search as branch-and-return over tree-structured states. At each round, it reads all sub-goal trees and uses textual UCB-style signals of value, uncertainty, and risk to choose among exploitation, exploration, pruning, and returning to an earlier branch point. The key idea is structured backtracking instead of linear continuation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes. The target setting is complex question answering via multi-step web search, browsing, evidence comparison, and synthesis. Likely baselines are greedy or less structured search agents. The claimed benefit is better budget control and more reliable evidence discovery, though exact gains require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes names commonly associated with Microsoft Research, such as Qingwei Lin and Dongmei Zhang, suggesting a systems-oriented agent paper if confirmed.

recommendation.zh: 方法有点意思，但离 pretrain 很远；把它当 inference-time search policy 设计参考即可，重点看树状态定义和 UCB 文本信号，别期待新的训练结论。
recommendation.en: Interesting as an inference-time search-policy design, but far from pretraining; read the tree-state formulation and textual UCB signals, not for a new training prior.

paper.title: WebChallenger: A Reliable and Efficient Generalist Web Agent
paper.abstract: Autonomous web navigation remains challenging for LLM agents, and the strongest generalist systems rely on proprietary reasoning models whose inference cost is prohibitive for the repetitive tasks where such agents would be most useful. We argue this gap stems not from insufficient model capability but from agent architectures that fail to replicate three human cognitive advantages: selective attention to relevant page regions, persistent memory of website structure, and procedural fluency with

summary.core_problem: 通用 Web Agent 依赖昂贵的专有推理模型，导致在重复性网页任务上成本过高且可靠性不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 架构和执行表示改进。它尝试用页面结构化表示、记忆和程序化交互模式降低对大模型规模和长链推理的依赖，对 agent 系统设计有一定参考价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WebChallenger 框架，核心是 PageMem：从 DOM 确定性构造的结构化页面表示，把网页组织成带短摘要的语义层级。其上设计三类机制：分治式 observation pipeline，让 agent 先浏览相关区域；持久化网站结构记忆；面向常见交互模式的 procedural fluency。方法重点是 agent scaffold，而不是训练新模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节、benchmark 名称、模型参数量或具体提升幅度。论文主张目标是在保持通用网页导航能力的同时降低对专有推理模型和高推理成本的依赖。

summary_en.core_problem: Generalist web agents often rely on expensive proprietary reasoning models, making them too costly and unreliable for repetitive web-navigation tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent architecture and execution representation. It tries to reduce dependence on large proprietary models by adding structured page representations, persistent memory, and reusable interaction procedures. This is relevant to agent system design, but only weakly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes WebChallenger, centered on PageMem, a deterministic DOM-derived page representation that exposes a webpage as a hierarchy of semantic sections with short summaries. On top of this substrate, it builds a divide-and-conquer observation pipeline, persistent memory of website structure, and procedural fluency for common interaction patterns. The main novelty is in the agent scaffold rather than model training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include full experimental details, benchmark names, model sizes, or numerical gains. The claimed goal is to maintain general web-navigation capability while reducing reliance on proprietary reasoning models and high inference cost.

recommendation.zh: PageMem 可作为 agent scaffold 备查；不要把结果解读成模型能力提升，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Keep PageMem as a scaffold reference; do not read it as evidence of stronger model capability, and the full paper is optional.

paper.title: Signal-Driven Observation for Long-Horizon Web Agents
paper.abstract: Web agents operating over long horizons ingest raw DOM and accessibility trees -- routinely tens of thousands of tokens -- at every action step, causing progressive context degradation that erodes reasoning well before tasks complete. We argue that this coupling of observation frequency to action frequency is an architectural mistake. Drawing on the insight from Recursive Language Models that querying a document outperforms reading it wholesale, we propose Signal-Driven Observation (SDO): a dedi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注长程 web agent 的一个结构性问题：每一步动作都重新吞下整棵 DOM / accessibility tree，会让上下文迅速膨胀并在任务完成前就损伤推理。
summary.importance: 价值在于它把“观察频率应不应等于动作频率”明确提出为 agent 架构问题，而不是单纯靠更长上下文硬扛。对做长上下文、检索式读写分离和 agent memory 的研究员有一点启发，但离基座 pretrain 仍较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Signal-Driven Observation（SDO）：引入一个专门的子调用读取完整 DOM，但只返回与当前任务相关的元素及 selector；并且只有在信号检测器触发时才重新观察，例如 URL 变化、新交互元素出现、动作失败或外部浏览器事件。核心思想是把 observation compression 作为架构层决策。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，这更像方法提案或立场论文，未看到完整 benchmark、模型规模或量化结果。实验部分大概率不是重点，主要贡献是问题定义与设计原则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural issue in long-horizon web agents: re-ingesting full DOM and accessibility trees at every action step causes context bloat and degrades reasoning before tasks finish.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is conceptual: observation frequency should not necessarily equal action frequency. That is mildly relevant to researchers thinking about long-context architectures, retrieval-style reading, and agent memory, though it is still far from core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Signal-Driven Observation (SDO) adds a dedicated sub-call that reads the full DOM but returns only task-relevant elements and selectors.
