summary_en.authors_note: Work by Carnegie Mellon University, core authors include well-known AI scholar Ruslan Salakhutdinov

recommendation.zh: 长程web agent任务构造逻辑可参考用于agent对齐数据合成，仅看基准构造部分即可，不用读全文
recommendation.en: Long-horizon web agent task construction logic can be referenced for agent alignment data synthesis, only read the benchmark construction section, no need to read full text

paper.title: Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
paper.abstract: Existing web agents typically initiate exploration from the root URL, which is inefficient for complex websites with deep hierarchical structures. Without a global view of the website's structure, agents frequently fall into navigation traps, explore irrelevant branches, or fail to reach target information within a limited budget. We propose Mango, a multi-agent web navigation method that leverages the website structure to dynamically determine optimal starting points. We formulate URL selection

summary.core_problem: 解决 web agent 从根 URL 盲目起步、在层级复杂网站中搜索效率低且容易陷入无关分支的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用 web agent 方法改进：把起始 URL 选择显式建模为全局优化问题，并结合多 agent 与记忆机制提升导航成功率。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于 agent 规划与预算分配，不在基座方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mango：先利用网站结构形成候选入口，再把 URL 选择建模为 multi-armed bandit，用 Thompson Sampling 动态分配导航预算；同时加入 episodic memory 记录历史尝试，帮助后续 agent 避免重复探索和导航陷阱。
summary.experiments: 在 WebVoyager 和 WebWalkerQA 上评测。摘要报告：使用 GPT-5-mini 时，WebVoyager 成功率 63.6%，比最佳 baseline 高 7.3%；WebWalkerQA 上达到 52.5%，也超过最佳基线。实验看起来是标准 agent benchmark 提升，但没有涉及训练范式或模型内部机制。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Purdue University。工作更像经典搜索/bandit 思路与 LLM web agent 的结合，而非新的 foundation model 训练方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient web navigation caused by starting from the root URL and exploring complex websites without a global structural view.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a web-agent method improvement: it explicitly optimizes starting-point selection and combines multi-agent exploration with memory. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly in planning and budget allocation, not in base-model methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mango first derives candidate entry URLs from website structure, then formulates URL selection as a multi-armed bandit and uses Thompson Sampling to allocate navigation budget. An episodic memory stores past trajectories so agents can avoid repeated failures and navigation traps.
summary_en.experiments: It is evaluated on WebVoyager and WebWalkerQA. The abstract reports 63.6% success on WebVoyager with GPT-5-mini, beating the best baseline by 7.3%, and 52.5% on WebWalkerQA, also above prior baselines. The gains look meaningful for agent benchmarks but do not speak to pretraining or model internals.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Purdue University. The work is best read as a combination of classical search/bandit ideas with LLM web agents, not as a new foundation-model training direction.

recommendation.zh: 有一点方法味道，但仍是 web agent 局部改良；只看 URL bandit 设定和主表即可，不会改变你对基座模型的 prior。
recommendation.en: There is some real method here, but it is still a local web-agent improvement; read the URL-bandit formulation and the main table, and move on.

paper.title: WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents

summary.core_problem: 解决 Web agent 长时程任务中“技能表示不落地/不可恢复”的问题：纯文本技能不可执行、纯代码技能不可解释，导致难以错误恢复与自适应。
summary.importance: 属于通用 Web agent 方法：提出“可执行程序 + 步级自然语言解释”的技能形态，并配套技能抽取/组织/部署流程；对 agent 记忆与可组合技能库有启发，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: WebXSkill 三阶段：①从（合成的）agent 轨迹中挖掘可复用动作子序列并抽象为参数化 action program，同时为每步配套自然语言指导；②用基于 URL 的图结构索引技能以便情境检索；③部署时支持直接执行与 agent 基于步级语义进行改写/恢复（两种模式）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称与量化结果细节；描述目标是提升长地平线网页任务成功率与可恢复性，并通过技能检索与可执行技能调用实现。

summary_en.core_problem: Address the grounding gap in long-horizon web agents: textual skills are not executable, while code skills are executable but opaque, hurting recovery and adaptation.
summary_en.importance: A method contribution for general web agents: an executable skill representation paired with step-level natural-language guidance, plus extraction/organization/deployment. Indirectly relevant to foundation pretraining via agent memory/compositionality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage WebXSkill: (1) mine reusable action subsequences from synthetic agent trajectories and abstract them into parameterized action programs with step-level NL guidance; (2) organize/index skills in a URL-based graph for context-aware retrieval; (3) deploy skills for direct execution and agent-driven adaptation/recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks or numeric gains; claims improvements on long-horizon web workflows via skill retrieval and executable skill invocation.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道“可执行程序+逐步解释”这类技能封装：只看技能抽取与恢复机制那节，能启发你做可调试的 web 任务记忆库。
recommendation.en: Worth noting the “executable program + stepwise rationale” skill packaging: read the extraction + recovery section to inform debuggable web-skill memory.

paper.title: AgentSwing: Adaptive Parallel Context Management Routing for Long-Horizon Web Agents

summary.core_problem: 解决长轨迹Web Agent在有限上下文窗口下的“上下文管理策略静态、随状态变化无法自适应”导致的搜索效率与最终精度下降问题。
summary.importance: 系统/方法创新：提出将长程成功分解为search efficiency与terminal precision的概率框架，并给出“并行分支+前瞻路由”的自适应上下文管理范式，对长程信息检索/网页操作类通用Agent具有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: AgentSwing在触发点并行展开多个采用不同上下文管理策略的分支（如保留/压缩/选择性记忆等的组合空间），通过lookahead routing评估并选择最有希望的继续分支，实现状态感知的动态策略切换，而非全程固定单一策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基座模型、参数规模与benchmark名称/提升幅度；仅说明在多种基准与多种agent backbone上验证有效（是否显著提升长程成功率与成本需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: Improving long-horizon web agents under limited context windows by replacing static context-management policies with adaptive strategies that respond to changing states, thereby improving search efficiency and final accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an adaptive context-management paradigm that decomposes long-horizon success into search efficiency and terminal precision, and uses parallel branching with lookahead routing—offering a general approach for long-form web interaction and information-seeking agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentSwing spawns multiple parallel branches at trigger points, each using a different context-management strategy (e.g., retain vs compress vs selective memory and their combinations). A lookahead routing mechanism evaluates branches and selects the most promising continuation, enabling dynamic strategy switching rather than committing to a single policy throughout.
summary_en.experiments: States effectiveness across multiple benchmarks and agent backbones, but the abstract does not specify the underlying models, benchmark names, or quantitative improvements in success rate/cost.

recommendation.zh: 上下文路由/并行分支是长程agent的实用招，但评测很容易被检索与网站分布污染；只看路由策略与消融，别信绝对SOTA。
recommendation.en: Parallel branching + context routing is a practical trick for long-horizon agents, but eval is easily confounded by web/retrieval distribution; read the routing policy and ablations, not the SOTA claim.
